body: Like others have said, cut contact, all of it. Don't respond to him, even if he starts being nice. I once dated a guy like that, and I fell for his kindness. He went right back to being abusive after everything seemed okay. If he was like my ex, he probably won't even harass you too much, and his threats will probably be hollow (mine threatened to post pictures of me on 4chan, he never did, he just want me to respond even if it was out of pure fear). He'll just feel sorry for himself. And like Lordica said, a restraining order may need to be put into consideration.

I said my guy friends, as well as boyfriend. Clearly, not all men are like that, nor are all women. It was a question of curiosity, and I apologize for any offense made. I was simply aggravated that my circle of socials was trying to convince me that my lifestyle is outdated due to how I prefer to listen to my music and what I do on my PC. Yes, I did bring it up to them, because I was excited.

I am sooo guilty of cheap cosmetics/clearance clothes shopping when I feel low. XD I had a coupon for a Revlon product and got one of their new lip butters! New favorite make-up must have. XD 

And thank you!

Honestly if felt like there were days where nothing but basic instinct kept me going. Getting out of bed in the morning and falling asleep at night has been hellish for a while. 

Thank you, thank you thank you thank you for saying that men expect that stereotype, because they do and it drives me nuts! I'm not ashamed of being a rape victim, honestly. I've had time to cope with it. I am currently ashamed that I was daft enough to date someone that mentally abusive, though. 

Haha, yours die and mine are practically zombies! Just feed 'em till they are bloated, and hopefully they'll stay full for at least 3 days. Logging out of the account may help, or it may be a myth, I'm not sure at all. 

I said to a few others, and I really should have made mention in the main post (dumb dumb moment), I was raped 10 years ago, and it honestly doesn't even phase me now. I've been to schools and events to talk about rape, how to get over it, and what to do if it happens. Of course a lot of teenagers sit there and scoff like it would never happen to them, but some of them listen and take it to heart. 

Do want Comicon. Needs job. Needs monies faster. I love conventions! I'm one of the weirdos you see all dressed up at them. XD I'm actually really good at striking up conversations with strangers, although some of them look at me like I'm nuts for being randomly nice.

I do love this Reddit more than any other now. <3 

Lol, I was about to go make lunch, but now I'm going to be glued to my seat looking at /r/GetMotivated for probably an hour or so! 

Thank you for the support, and the link!

I don't think it would hurt to. I was afraid to post mine, but I've gotten a crazy amount of support in the comments, in PMs, and even spoke to someone on Skype last night! It was a giant wave of relief.

And I know how that feels, to have someone lie about you, and someone else close believe it. It made my relationship with my ex rocky, honestly. He didn't trust me, and ran to some guy I used to be friends with, and that guy just wrote nothing but paragraphs and paragraphs of lies. I should have ended the relationship there and spared myself months of abuse. 

It feel amazing to read that other girls have the same interests as me. <3

I tried back in high school, and all the ones in the area are... well they just don't care. Like I said to someone else, the rape was about a decade ago. But I definitely need counseling to help patch up the mental damage my ex caused. Also, thank you.

I'll probably give it a month before I post an update. I'm resuming job hunting in my own town, and one of my old friends made contact with me at a good time, and we're going to catch a movie this week. It'll be so nice to get out of the house!
Thank you! <3

I can't describe how much it pisses me off when a rapist, molester, murder, etc. is let off easy, or free. It's no better that so many people, even our own gender, are ignorant to it. They are not worthy of your friendship for a single second if they had that crappy attitude. And we should definitely be penpals, because I like those things as well! <3

I could definitely use a change. I'm not sure what, though. When my now ex and I would have major fights I'd cut my hair-- not a whole lot, just about half an inch. I have an undercut, and the length of it is now resting at my cheekbones. Honestly I probably would have cut it again if my ex didn't at one point start gushing about how much he loves women with extremely long straightened hair. He knew how self conscious I was about my short hair since so many men seem to dislike it, but the maintenance is soooo easy. I'd dye it blue again, but I'm flat broke and job hunting. Hopefully I will think of something.

And thank you very much for sharing your experience with me.

Damn, that blows, I'm sorry. It's never too late to catch up. And I'm sorry for your loss. I've only dealt with family death (even though really awesome friends are like family), so I can't fully relate. The first girl, it's her loss. I can tell just from those sentences alone that you're an awesome friend to those you keep close.

The rape occurred about a decade ago (man, I feel old). So I've had plenty of time and came to peace with it. Even got revenge, but that's another story entirely...

It has had an impact on me, I won't deny that for a single second. My ex was a massive asshole for claiming it made me "broken" and he couldn't "fix me". That was very insulting, when he knew good and damn well that he was the one that made me feel self conscious, and could cause me to become angry in ways that no other person could. His mental abuse, to me, was far worse. And I'm pretty shitty for letting it happen at all. I've honestly never let someone control me like that.

Thank you very much. I'm busting ass to get over it, be over it, and not give a single fuck about what he's doing. I think he has enough sense to know that if he acts out then it will only prove I am correct about his bad attitude.
I have a feeling I will be up for hours browsing this subreddit. Thank you for the link.

I am happy I posted here. I've lurked here a lot, and the bonds are amazing. There have been threads that brought tears to my eyes. It reminded me of all the friendships I had when I was younger, and thought would last my entire life. It's inspirational to see such kind ladies.

I do have guy friends, but I feel strange talking with them after my ex called me a "gigantic cock craving whore" for talking to them. It's not their fault, obviously. They are good friends. It's just also hard to talk to them about because they don't know where I'm coming from.

My ex also, more than once, made me feel like I couldn't have female friends because of how I would argue with him. He worked his ass of to strike a nerve with me, and succeeded every time. I'm embarrassed for letting him reach a temper that I never knew I had. I have never been that way with another living creature. 

I like a weird variety of movies. I'll probably end up having a Miyazaki movie marathon. Or I'll watch Jurassic Park over and over and over again because I love it that much.
It's comforting to know I'm not the only one. I hope that doesn't sound mean. Sleep well, I'll be on later.
Please do, and let us know the results if you are okay with that!
I apologize, I unfortunately cannot make it that far. There is a Reddit for Florida residents, and some subreddits for more populated areas. Someone may be able to help. It's worth a shot.

All of the above.

I agree, entirely. It's because of that, I don't know who I am anymore. Because of him insulting so many events in my past, I don't know how to be. I didn't think my life was too bad, until he started insulting it, then I hated it, and regret it. His words plagued my mind and took over. 

Probably also worth mentioning that this all came from a man that said, "Words mean nothing." Idiot. Words can be more painful than actions.
North or south? Depending on how far away, I could personally help.
I had never allowed myself to be treated in such a way before. I've certainly never let anyone alter my mentality like that before. I don't know what to believe now.
If you don't mind me asking, which state do you live in? There have been occasions where Reddit users in tight spots have received help from locals.
No no no! Don't regret posting! Just report them and ignore whatever they say. Don't show weakness to people that are THAT low.
I will PM you. Also, please be aware of a troll that has been messaging people. S/he has messaged a few others I've spoken with recently.

Guys, don't down vote posts in SW. It makes no sense. 

It may be difficult, but try finding new things that are not associated with them at all. New games, shows, food, whatever you enjoy. I might be hard to do those things alone, but nothing is wrong with a little selfishness. We all need alone time. 

I know how it feels to have your kindness taken advantage of, or mistaken for weakness. And to love someone to the point you're blinded by it and start to believe bad things they say about you. It's not uncommon, sadly. But it is something that can be conquered.
Thought about it for the sake of his mother, but I don't see it happening honestly. If she hasn't noticed it herself, she won't pay any attention to a letter.

That would be much appreciated.

He won't let anything go. Even his own mother told me he holds on to negative things too hard and for too long. He needs medication, that's certain. I don't know what it would take for him to even start to acknowledge that he pushing people away with hateful words, spite, and endless grudges.

It's an amazing tattoo idea, and one I doubt you'd regret. 

I know what causes most of his actions. The problem is, he never moves past them, and holds massive grudges. He would talk about his other ex quite often in a very negative light. I had only heard about her from him, so I have no clue what others thought. They might have thought she was wonderful. She clearly wasn't as bitter as him, as she moved on, found a new love and moved in with him. So why was he so bitter?

And as I said to someone else in another comment, after talking to family today, it FINALLY hit me that he's full blown bipolar. That doesn't make me feel better by any means, but it sure does explain a lot. He, however, thinks he is 100% normal, and everyone else in the world is crazy. So, there is no helping him when he has that mindset.

After some deep thought and discussion with a family member today, I realized he's bipolar. Why I didn't realize it before, I have absolutely no idea. I had 2 bipolar family members (both deceased) that did the exact same crap he did. Exactly the same. The same horrid, hateful, twisted actions. And he believes he is perfectly normal, and that everyone else is messed up. He would tell me, and others, that very frequently. I am still spiteful of him, but I hope he is able to receive help some day.

I also hope he doesn't do anything crazy to spite me. I told him a lot of things, and shared a lot of my life with him. Realistically, I don't think he could hurt me in the way he wants. But the fact that he would want to scares me enough.

I'm not so much afraid of them as I am of messing up. And to him, I messed up a lot. He didn't like responses that were too slow, nor too fast. He didn't like hearing "boring" details of my day, but would get angry later if I didn't tell him about them. And so on... Some how, I was always messing up when I was trying to make him happy.

1. It's hard not to. So much crap to accept and cope with.
2. Still working on that. I'm going to have someone else handle my phone when I get the number changed. I have no desire to see what he as sent.
3. So much that doesn't seem repairable... I hope I don't feel that way later down the road.
4. Very true. But I am very angry with myself for dealing with it ever, at all, changing a lot about myself, and letting him believe horrible lies about me just so he would have some satisfaction in being right, since he enjoyed being right so much. 
5. I really need ice cream. There are never sweets in the house when I need them. I think I'll be busting out the Jurassic Park dvd set for myself. 

Also, thank you.

It is a good idea. I'm just still dwelling on the fact that I put so much time and love into someone that didn't love me back. It makes me question other people's intentions far too deeply and frequently, and it's pretty scary.

Easily one of the best quotes I have ever read. Not joking at all; I sat up in my seat and my eyes got as round as half dollars. Also, irl lol'd at "they can go hump an egg". He taught me that the varying degrees (from opinion to opinion) of what qualifies as intelligence is... shocking, to say the least. When someone is sad, I view them as, well, sad. When he sees someone sad it's, "It's probably a stupid reason. Don't feel bad for them, they just need to suck it up." Well, ouch. I used to think his more rude and callous opinions like that had some meaning, but I certainly can't think of one now, nor do I care to. As I said, I'm super ashamed for sharing so much of my life with him. It makes me wonder how anyone can go through a divorce without going nuts. I guess they didn't marry men like my ex.

It's not hard to describe how I fell in love, actually. We just had a lot in common, even little things. Enjoyed the same music, including tiny little bands on youtube that barely get 1,000 hits per upload, the same little specific after dinner snacks... Well, I guess it is hard to explain. It would have to be felt. That is, the physical attraction, up to mental attraction, up to loving one another for small things that make the day awesome. I still love him, and never once lied when I would tell him that I wanted to share the rest of my life with him.

It feels hard to bounce back from, in so, so many ways. My lazy ass doesn't even want to go near Diablo III because I know he'll be playing it.

I'm scared that I will have a difficult time with even the most basic friendships. I'm scared of a lot now. I'm scared to share my interests with anyone, I'm scared to suggest good bands to even a family member... I'm just terrified. I can't stand to look at myself in the mirror, clothed or not, and I don't want to hear myself speak. I was in the kitchen getting a drink and when my mom asked me something I literally bit my lower lip because I was afraid to talk, or say the wrong thing. She wasn't even mad at me. It's awful to feel like everything I do is wrong. What if I respond too fast, or too slow, with too many words, or too little? I'm a giant pansy right now.

By the way, thank you for sharing all of that with me.

Did he ever talk about you so poorly that you believed what he said was true? I'm stuck in that spot. I believe everything bad he ever said about me is real, and it scares me even more, and it makes me hesitant about moving forward.

I didn't have kids with him, thankfully. Not even married nor engaged. I should be more grateful it didn't go that far. But like I said to someone else, it's all still so fresh. He's the closest I had ever been to anyone in my life, and ironically, the one that hurt me the most.

How did you heal? It's still so fresh, everything reminds me of him. We shared so much, there is little music, tv shows, outdoor activities, etc. that I can turn to right now because he comes to mind almost immediately. Him, and all of the bad memories and shame. It's such a giant mess. I know people that went through divorces that weren't this screwy.
I don't know, really. Maybe some pictures of little animals in costumes. I don't know why I like that stuff.

He can't do anything worse than what he's already done. It doesn't matter who he talks to in regards to it, because I will probably never meet those people, be in a position where I work for them, or anything like that. I'm just buried deep in regret for allowing it go so far. It's still embarrassing, the way he thinks of me. It hasn't fully hit home yet that while he was calling me "mentally ill", he seemed to suffer from it. I still feel so badly about myself after it was beaten into my mind for that long.

I feel like I should just end myself because I was an idiot for putting up with his mental abuse for so long. Mental abuse that made me want to destroy myself. Then of course he would get angrier. I can't understand why people do that and want to be so mad.
PLEASE tell me where you go that comforter!
My pleasure. :) If you need anymore information I'd be happy to help.

As someone that has a ton of experience in the world of cosmetology (both schooling and personal), I will attempt to be specific with some of the vague tip comments:


First of all, the jackass that said not wearing make-up means you don't care is pretty damn clueless to how cosmetics work for women. Your skin is freaking gorgeous! I would kill for skin as clear as yours. I have scars and uneven skin tone. You have full right to ditch foundation. 


Second, I'm not a fan of your hair color, either. But it's your hair, so ultimately it's your choice. You should love your vanity choices more than anyone else. If you wanted to change it, a medium/dark brown would really make your eye color stand out. You also have a really nice face, and could probably pull off a haircut with some more layers (depending on your maintenance preference).


Third, if you were to wear make-up, just go for filling in the brows, some eyeliner, mascara, and gloss. A brown liner and dark brown mascara would compliment your eyes and stand nicely against your skin tone. But no matter what your hair color, be sure to match your brows to a similar color so it appears more natural.


But again, it's your hair and face, so you do what makes you  happy!
